_about: Legend class id -> converted symbol block (static/Symbols_dxf, made from static/Symbols_dwg with LibreDWG dwg2dxf). match: 'name' = the block file is named after the class; 'visual' = matched by eye against the legend drawing. keep_text: keep the block's own TEXT / MTEXT (otherwise only the shape is used and the OCR text of the drawing stays). Classes not listed keep their original strokes from the drawing.
